comments.body_html:
Only do this if you want to be blacklisted from any SPT related support. Mods are used to edit the values of these configs in memory instead of manually editing the files. That way you can safely uninstall the mod to revert the changes.

If you do this manually, you WILL fuck up and then support staff will have to deal with telling you that you fucked up. Just don’t bother.
